finishes.name: Gunmetal Gray
finishes.notes: SF-003 Pro machined gunmetal. Hex sampled from Sunshine's product photo (spool face on white, mid-tones).

finishes.name: Gunmetal & Black
finishes.notes: SF-003 Pro '& Black': black frame, foot and hub (hex between the photo's lit #404040 and shaded #232323), gunmetal spool (the model's trim).

models.name: Sunshine SF-001
models.notes: Die-cast large-arbor reel, sold on Amazon and sunshine-fishing.com as the 'SF Large Arbor', alone or preloaded. Rim, width (inside spool) and rated capacity from Sunshine's spec table (product image FRDC-SF001-34-KTB-4, sunshine-fishing.com, Oct 2026), which also gives the inner diameters 1.81, 2.20 and 2.40″. Spool is estimated as rim − 0.24″. Matt black uses the base black.

models.name: Sunshine SF-003 Pro
models.notes: CNC-machined mid-arbor reel, sold on Amazon (model SF003PRO) and sunshine-fishing.com. Rim, width and spool inner (arbor) diameter for the 3/4 (74/21/40 mm) and 7/8 (94/27/50 mm) from the Amazon listings' bullets (B0FJXQYSNT, B0FJX2BFLB, Oct 2026); the 5/6 is interpolated between them (estimate). No rated capacity is published. Spool is estimated as rim − 0.24″. The Moss Green and Yellow listings differ only in the preloaded line; '& Black' has a black frame and hub with the gunmetal spool (trim).
